author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez continue their rewatch of The Infinity Saga with Marvel Studios' Avengers: Infinity War, tracking the Mad Titan's hunt for the six Infinity Stones across the galaxy. While we may have seen him before, Thanos finally makes his move and the stakes have never been higher. They dig into Thor's detour with the Guardians, Gamora’s fate, the Battle of Wakanda, and the gut-wrenching choice Vision and Wanda are forced to make. Iman and Frank also spend time on the showdown on Titan, where one bad call tips the scales, before turning to the fallout of the Snap itself and what it means for every hero left standing. It may be a more tragic conversation than usual, but one that sets up everything still to come.
